sec: Bone turnover markers and vitamin D mechanism · p868

items.q: Match marker to category — 1) TRAP  2) CTP  3) NTX  4) Osteocalcin … A) Formation  B) Resorption
items.exp: Resorption markers: TRAP, CTP, NTX; formation: total/bone ALP, osteocalcin, PICP, PINP. (Book p868)

items.q: Which is a bone FORMATION marker (odd one out among resorption markers)?
items.exp: bsALP is a formation marker; TRAP, CTP, NTX are resorption markers. (Book p868)

items.q: The formation markers PICP and PINP are propeptides of:
items.exp: PICP/PINP = C- and N-terminal propeptides of procollagen type I. (Book p868)

items.q: Vitamin D is a Group I hormone acting via:
items.exp: Group I hormone with intracellular receptor in nucleus — heterodimer receptor type 2. (Book p868)

items.q: Match the vitamin D receptor complex — 1) Activated VDR partner  2) DNA element bound … A) VDRE  B) RXR
items.exp: 1,25-OH vit D activates VDR which heterodimerizes with RXR and binds VDRE to drive gene transcription. (Book p868)
